mechanism: Oxacillin may displace torsemide from protein binding and both drugs are renally eliminated, potentially increasing torsemide levels and diuretic/electrolyte effects; additionally, loop diuretics can reduce renal perfusion affecting antibiotic clearance.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes, renal function, and fluid status during concurrent use; ensure adequate hydration and consider dose adjustments if significant hyperkalemia or hypokalemia develops.
